page: Microsoft Azure M416s_12_v3 is an ultra-high-memory instance belonging to the MSHighMemoryv3 family, operating on Microsoft Hyper-V. Built upon the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors, the instance delivers 416 dedicated vCPUs alongside 11,400 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a massive memory-to-core ratio of 27.4 GB per vCPU, placing it among the most dense memory profiles available in public cloud environments.

Hardware allocation is dedicated, eliminating CPU contention from adjacent tenants. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, operating strictly without ephemeral scratch disks, but it supports external Azure Premium Storage attachments for persistent I/O throughput. Furthermore, the configuration contains no hardware accelerators or GPUs, focusing exclusively on massive memory capacity and multi-threaded CPU execution.

From an efficiency perspective, the platform consolidates extreme enterprise workloads into a single system footprint, reducing operational complexity associated with large distributed architectures. Given the absence of local ephemeral storage, network and block storage configurations must be planned carefully to handle the I/O demands of the in-memory footprint. The M416s_12_v3 is primarily designed for mission-critical in-memory enterprise databases, large-scale SAP HANA deployments, and massive in-memory analytics workloads requiring continuous memory residency.
description: Microsoft Azure M416s_12_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine within the MSHighMemoryv3 series, driven by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel platform, the instance provides 416 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 11,400 GB of system RAM, yielding a high memory ratio of 27.4 GB per core. The host features no integrated local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on Azure Premium Storage capabilities for persistent volume attachments. This high compute and memory capacity enables massive multi-threaded scale without hypervisor-level CPU oversubscription. The server is engineered specifically for ultra-large in-memory databases, including mission-critical SAP HANA systems and enterprise-scale real-time data processing engines where colossal memory capacity is non-negotiable.
